data.content:
Here's a summary of the migration and the **4 breaking changes** addressed:

### Breaking Changes in EF Core 9 Cosmos DB

| # | Breaking Change | Impact on Your Data | Fix Applied |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | **Discriminator renamed** `"Discriminator"` → `"$type"` | EF9 can't read 500K existing docs; your raw SQL `c.Discriminator` queries break | `HasDiscriminator<string>("Discriminator")` explicitly preserves the old property name |
| **2** | **JSON `id` format changed** `"Product|123"` → `"123"` | EF9 can't find any existing document by key — all lookups fail | `modelBuilder.HasDiscriminatorInJsonIds(true)` re-enables the `EntityType|Key` format |
| **3** | **Sync APIs removed** (`ToList()`, `First()`, etc.) | `ToList()` throws `InvalidOperationException` at runtime | Changed to `await ToListAsync()` |
| **4** | **`HasIndex()` not supported** | Throws at model build time for Cosmos provider | Removed the call |

The only remaining build error (`CS5001` — no entry point) is pre-existing since the project has no `Program.cs`.
